connections.why: An effective recital depends on stylistic interpretation and communication
Both require control of harmony, texture and structure to a brief
Mastering technical exercises supplies the harmonic craft used in composition
Compositional techniques learned in exercises underpin free composition
The two compulsory areas of study anchor analysis of harmony and form
Classical instrumental forms develop into Romantic programme music
Late-Romantic expansion of harmony leads into twentieth-century innovation
Blues and swing in popular song feed directly into instrumental jazz
Baroque textures and tonality lay the groundwork for the Classical style
Classical harmony is the model for the harmony exercises
Stylistic knowledge from the areas of study informs performance choices
Twentieth-century techniques offer a palette for original composition
Popular and jazz idioms are common starting points for free composition
Understanding jazz style informs idiomatic performance and improvisation
